svg.title: Most Used Languages
svg.desc: Most used languages across public non-fork repositories, each repository weighted equally: Python 23.5%, HTML 12.8%, JavaScript 9.6%, C 8.6%, Rust 7.4%, Dart 7.2%, C++ 6.7%, TypeScript 4.9%, Java 4.5%, Other 14.9%.
